To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the combination of human intelligence and machine learning algorithms is a key for the future success of digital pathology, (ii) the development of a "grand unifying theory" is a prerequisite for the success of digital pathology and (iii) the combination of data sources and the integration of the data in a digital workflow is a key for future success.
the augmented pathologist will be the result of a well-balanced collaboration between human and machine intelligence.

the augmented pathologist will be able to: (i) make use of large and complex data sets, (ii) learn from only few examples, (iii) understand and interpret the data, (iv) make use of the human expert's knowledge, (v) explain the decisions and (vi) provide a human-readable output of its reasoning.
